name: Sly reduces Woodland Adept's cooldown by 10% per Advantage stack (#860)
contract: Sly 560339 (Ranger class ability, CharacterAdvancement 6347) reads "Your Woodland Adept and Elude now triggers a $s1% reduced cooldown for each stack of Advantage active when cast". It is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, EffectBasePoints -11 + DieSides 1 = -10, masked to SpellFamily 27 word0 0x80000000. The only records it can reach are Ambuscade 804936 and 802612 'Skullpiercer Focus Regen Advantage Hidden', a 5-stack hidden Advantage companion like 704337/801429/801700 whose effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, value 0, masked to word2 0x4000, which in family 27 is exactly Woodland Adept 570015 and Elude 801345. So Sly turns that companion into -10% cooldown per stack, and the aura amount is multiplied by its stack count. Nothing kept 802612 on the Ranger: aura_ascension_ranger_advantage mirrored Advantage 804329 onto the other three companions only. Woodland Adept has RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 180000. Control: with 3 Advantage and no Sly the cast still costs the full 180 sec. With Sly and 3 Advantage the companion's effect 1 must read -30 and the next cast must cost 180000 * 0.7 = 126000 ms. Before the fix 802612 is absent and the cooldown stays 180 sec.

steps.label: The hidden cooldown companion mirrors the three Advantage stacks

Leave the Elude stealth before learning Sly

Three Advantage again, with Sly known
Sly makes the companion a 10% cooldown reduction per stack
Woodland Adept with Sly and three Advantage
DISCRIMINATING: three Advantage stacks cut the cooldown by 30%
